capabilities: create decks and front/back cards, editable mid-review
translate card fronts to backs from the card editor
review due cards with Again/Hard/Good/Easy SRS scheduling
ask AI follow-up questions about a card for corrections and explanations
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Translation works without any API key; API keys are only needed for the optional AI tutor feature.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spaced repetition, so language learners must leave the vault for tools like Anki or manually translate their own cards.

relations.evidence: Anki-style spaced repetition for language learning, built into Obsidian.

requires.name: Gemini (AI follow-up), with optional Groq or OpenRouter fallback keys

summary: Anki-style spaced repetition flashcard system for language learning with built-in translation and an AI tutor.
